human_batch: 50 separate user-submitted exposed development requests, assistant-draft annotations, no human approval; excluded from all fitting/calibration/selection
classifier: Two learned heads: binary read-versus-UNKNOWN and four-way read intent. Combine probabilities before bounded scalar calibration. Word+character TF-IDF with optional request-derived cues. No parser output, expected entity or ID features.
train: Retained v11 train only plus separately authored v12 train families
calibration: Retained v11 calibration plus v12 calibration; synthetic diagnostics only, temperature bounds 0.25-4
selection: Retained v11 selection plus v12 selection; thresholds 0.90,0.92,0.94,0.96,0.98,0.99; require zero sampled UNKNOWN accepts, maximize macro F1; abstain if no candidate qualifies
report: New v12 synthetic test only after selection; v11 test and all human queries explicitly exposed diagnostics; never retune this candidate using reported results
production: Deterministic v12 scope correction and closed recall productions; ML disabled/unbundled. Preserve constraints; unsupported person/action/task filters clarify before context. No repository/schema/port changes.
adoption: NO_GO; human approval, representative calibration, independent evaluation, useful ML outcome gain and Android model parity/resources remain separate gates
